source.retrievalMethod: manual research capture from public HTTPS source
source.digestScope: UTF-8 JSON over the four declared source-capture fields, with object keys sorted lexicographically and no insignificant whitespace; not the publisher’s full HTTP response

rules: do not infer licence or access when absent

verification.digestMethod: project-json-c14n-v1 (sorted object keys; compact UTF-8 JSON); not RDF Dataset Canonicalization

limitations: The receipt proves integrity of the captured transformation inputs and outputs; it does not prove that the upstream source was correct.
The receipt is not a government attestation and does not grant API access.
